title: Accepting an Unexpected Change of Plans
paragraphs: Having planned a long-awaited family vacation for months, Nadia felt deeply disappointed when her father suddenly fell ill just two days before their scheduled departure date.
Canceling the trip felt unfair after all the planning, but Nadia reminded herself that Allah knows better than she does what is truly good for her family right now.
Instead of complaining, she focused on caring for her father, quietly trusting that the vacation could happen another time when everyone felt more at peace.
A week later, her father recovered fully, and looking back, Nadia realized that rushing off on vacation while he was sick would have left her constantly worried anyway.
She later rescheduled the trip for a month later, and this time, everyone truly enjoyed it together, without the underlying anxiety that would have accompanied the earlier date.
